pages.text: Settings are stored in config/AdvancedGenetics.toml. All 38 abilities have individual toggles. Machine capacities, costs, timings, success chances, and overclock limits remain configurable. Defaults preserve the original balance.

hardMode defaults to false; enabling it rejects Basic DNA in the infuser. geneSharing defaults to false. basicGeneChance defaults to 0.5. plasmidRequirement defaults to 24. The legacy cloning_machine settings are retained, but the source mod has no playable cloning machine.

Operators can use:$(br2)/gene add <players> <gene>$(br)/gene remove <players> <gene>$(br)/gene clear <players>$(br2)Gene names use lowercase underscores, such as night_vision. Key bindings can be changed in Minecraft Controls.
